findings.title: The dismiss button no longer stays at the right edge
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container means the `float: right` on its `button` child is ignored. The button now sits immediately after the description instead of being pushed to the right edge, changing the small-action layout. Use a flex-compatible alignment rule, such as `margin-left: auto`, for the button.
